subject.title: EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError: session GC deletes file while agent is still running

question: Should this be fixed now as an active-work guard in cron/session cleanup, or folded into the broader session storage and cron retention lifecycle work?
rationale: The bug is concrete, but the repair boundary crosses cron retention, active session-work admissions, transcript archiving, and storage migration seams, so maintainer intent is needed before spawning another fix branch.

options.title: Add Active-Work Guard Now
options.body: Update the cron reaper/lifecycle mutation path to skip active admitted cron run sessions and add focused regression coverage while leaving broader storage cleanup to existing work.

options.title: Fold Into Storage Lifecycle Work
options.body: Keep this open as the canonical tracker and fix it only as part of the broader session/transcript storage migration or retention redesign.

options.title: Temporarily Relax Pruning
options.body: Disable or lengthen ambiguous cron run-session pruning until lifecycle ownership is explicit, trading disk/store growth for lower active-run loss risk.

recommendation.title: Add Active-Work Guard Now
recommendation.body: Update the cron reaper/lifecycle mutation path to skip active admitted cron run sessions and add focused regression coverage while leaving broader storage cleanup to existing work.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the closest session cleanup lifecycle seam and are the clearest routing owner for the active-admission boundary choice.
